quote: Sometimes you hold onto people who only love you in fragments. You accept silence where warmth should be. You build a home inside a revolving door. You whisper apologies for taking up too much space. And you wonder why your chest feels so unbearably heavy. Because you are trying to bloom inside a winter storm.
